about_the_game:
Demo time!

This demo should be considered to be a Pre-Release version of the main game. We plan on launching to Early Access later this year. For now realize that this demo build has core aspects but lacks polish in many ways.

What is this game about

The game at it's core is a 3d RPG with elements of survival, base building and Rogue lite. You do missions where you level up from scratch every time. Go talk to your trainer to level up when you have enough XP! As you complete missions you receive rewards to build up your home base.

Story: From 80's Rocker to Medieval Fantasy Hero, not bad dude!

In Medieval Darkness you create your 80's rocker but you are soon swept into the fantasy world of Ithule. The creator of this world has chosen you to help save it from an ancient evil.

Game modes:

The full game includes many game modes include gathering materials to fortify your new home in Naughtwood, adventuring to hidden dungeons for loot and glory, and defending friendly villages against the onslaught of evil.

This Demo has the Gathering mode only


Embark on dangerous expeditions to collect wood, stone, metal, and other valuable resources. Use these resources to further build your home and craft mighty equipment and fortifications. While out for gathering, NPC's may ask you to do quests for them. Help them to further the story line!
